body_markdown:
World of Warcraft The War Within is nearing it's end, and it feels surreal that this will be the last season before the Midnight DLC.


The brand-new expansion is now here and we're going to rank all of the DPS specs as we head into the first season of Midnight.


Here's all we know.


## World of Warcraft Midnight: All DPS Specs Ranked


WoW Midnight is aiming to re-invent World of Warcraft in many facets as not only are there major changes coming to all 39 specializations in the game, but the addition of Player Housing is a breath of fresh air.


There's been a ton of class changes, and heading into Midnight, we would rank the following specs as such:


S Tier


- Augmentation Evoker
- Devourer Demon Hunter
- Demonology Warlock


A Tier


- Fire Mage
- Devestation Evoker
- Unholy Death Knight
- Enhancement Shaman
- Elemental Shaman


B Tier


- Havoc Demon Hunter
- Forst Mage


- Arcane Mage
- Fury Warrior
- Frost Death Knight
- Beastmaster Hunter
- Marksmanship Hunter
- Shadow Priest
- Subtlety Rogue


C Tier


- Outlaw Rogue
- Assassination Rogue
- Feral Druid
- Destruction Warlock
- Retibution Paladin


- Balance Druid


D Tier


- Arms Warrior
